Camera and microphone cannot be switched on your Android version.

Switching them needs Android 12 or newer, which added the system setting the app uses. There is no older way to do it, so no lock or unlock delay setting will change this.

Every other feature on this screen works normally.

Enabling Airplane Mode will disable WiFi, Bluetooth, Mobile Data, and NFC regardless of their individual settings.

Exception: if a WiFi hotspot is active, Airplane Mode is skipped on lock so tethered devices stay connected - the same exception WiFi and Mobile Data already have.

Use this for maximum privacy when the device is locked.

Battery Saver reduces background activity and may limit some app features.

It does not directly disable radios (WiFi, Bluetooth, etc.) but can affect sync, location accuracy, and background processing.

Useful for extending battery life when locked for long periods.
Only if Privacy Flip turned it on
Free, open source, no ads, for your privacy.\nConsider donating to support ongoing development.
